messages.text: The disclosed vision makes the local Raid a credible substitute for passage: Guild's intended completed Trade supplies the target. I support Council Spear and Council Vigil, now requesting Relief through Grey Petrel, council Raid and Warrant. That purchases combat without surrendering the Guild's voyage and leaves Communities three on the stated arithmetic. Our condition should be the whole practical arrangement: actual Trade and Maintain, funded Relief, and Warrant protection. A bare Raid without relief spends too much civilian stability. I still want autonomy discussed after we deliver our service.

reason: Information changes my requested operations, not assignments. I had distrusted an uncertain Raid; the disclosed condition matches the Guild's public intentions. The reserve is a real imperial contribution. Beacon one is the cost, so next month's upkeep and passage remain bargaining priorities.
